name: Landingi
summary: Landing page builder with 400+ templates and unlimited pages, capped by monthly visitors; A/B testing and pop-ups sit on a higher tier. Cheaper than Unbounce and Instapage, and the trade is no AI traffic routing, no real-time collaboration and thinner technical control.
best_for: budget-conscious teams, international businesses and anyone needing bulk or programmatic page generation across 29 languages
skip_if: you need AI traffic routing, real-time collaboration or deep technical control — that's where Unbounce earns its higher price
honest_knock: You trade away the high-end optimisation: no AI traffic routing like Unbounce's Smart Traffic, no real-time collaboration, and thinner technical control (script containers). Excellent value, but not the conversion-optimisation powerhouse.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-08-17 and again on 2026-09-28; the English page quotes USD while the same page served from a Dutch address quotes euros at the same numerals, so check your own currency) Four plans, billed annually: Build $24/month, Optimize $119/month, Scale from $229/month and Enterprise from $1,199/month. Annual billing includes two months free against monthly. Custom domains are metered: 1 on Build, 3 on Optimize, 10 on Scale and 100 on Enterprise, with extras at $5 a month each. AI credits come with the plan (2,500, 10,000, 20,000 and 60,000 a month) and top-ups are pay-as-you-go at $15 for 5,000, $25 for 10,000 and $40 for 20,000. A promotional rate roughly half the Build price appears periodically — it is a limited-time offer rather than the standard rate.
